# Open — what the home is still waiting for

Generated at each release from the home repository's records, each cell shortened. A harvest reads it before offering anything: an experiment queued here is one this repository may be able to run, and a candidate listed here is extended with a new occurrence (`extends <slug>`), not offered again.

| a-session-socket-is-a-credential | with a master open, confirm a second local process opens a session through the socket without authenticating, and that an explicit close removes it | minutes |
| coverage-measures-execution | run a mutation tool over one repository's suite and compare the mutation score with its coverage | an hour |
| a-check-must-be-seen-to-fail | for every check in a gate, record whether a planted violation was ever seen to turn it red; count the ones never seen | an hour per gate |

| sanitised-value-must-replace-the-raw | a lint rule that flags a sanitised binding whose source name is still read afterwards in the same scope, run across a repository; count how often the raw name survives | an hour |
| reproduce-the-checkout-not-only-the-environment | for every check in a gate, run it once from a clean export of the commit and once in the working tree; count the checks whose answers disagree | an hour per gate |
| one-write-gate-makes-read-only-real | run a suite against the real store in read-only mode with the store's access log enabled; count the writes that reached it anyway | an hour |
| untrusted-package-is-parsed-never-loaded | run the forged size constructions and the nine planted packages against a second, independently written reader; record peak allocation and each reason | an hour |
| read-a-snapshot-at-its-own-end | measure feature degradation at 1, 3, 7 and 14 days of refresh delay | an hour |
| derive-state-from-one-clock | run one time-driven piece both ways, accumulated deltas and derived from the clock, for its full length on the target; record the divergence at the end | an hour |
| validate-each-transformation-run | run the formatter unguarded over saved dirty trees in a scratch copy; count runs the guard would have rejected | an hour |
| unrunnable-system-moves-the-gate | build a startup that resolves the full dependency graph with stand-ins for hardware and credentials; count past startup failures it would have caught | hours |
| sweep-the-rendered-extremes | give a reviewer default-configuration screenshots of each recorded layout defect and count how many they flag | an hour |
| persist-inputs-derive-verdicts | preferences: in a store that saves every value, count users whose stored value equals the shipped default; change the default in a test build and count who is affected | an hour |
| absence-is-a-third-value | for each boolean in a schemaless store, count documents where it is missing and compare what the query layer and the application each conclude for them | an hour |
| kill-switch-reaches-every-path | for each switch, enumerate the feature's writers, readers and schedulers, flip it in a test and count the paths it does not stop | an hour per switch |
| in-process-guarantees | run two workers against the same resource in staging and fire concurrent requests; record double executions | an hour |
| retry-over-irreversible-effect | inject a lost response on the call between the two services and observe whether the downstream effect happens twice | an hour |
| test-double-fidelity | run each fake's test cases against the real dependency in an emulator and count the disagreements | an hour per fake |
| secrets-survive-rotation | rotate each secret in staging; count stored records that stop verifying and caches that keep serving | an hour per secret |
| censoring-is-information | train with unresolved rows labelled negative and with a horizon; compare calibration on the latest months | hours |

| population-by-outcome | train on the filtered and on the full population; evaluate both on the unfiltered test block and report the ranking-metric difference | hours |

| persist-inputs-derive-verdicts | at a policy change, count records whose stored verdict disagrees with the recomputed one | needs production traffic |
| refuse-only-on-unassertable-evidence | for each refusing signal, count distinct subjects per value in production and whether any value is client-settable | needs production traffic |
| same-answer-or-refuse | replay a period through both paths and count decisions that cross a threshold | needs production traffic |
